products.name: PET Closures
products.description: Commercially manufactured polyethylene terephthalate (PET) closures for beverage, food, and non-food containers, produced using proprietary CapFormer Systems and thermoforming technology. These closures are designed for recyclability, lightweighting, and enhanced performance such as improved gas barrier properties and compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., tethered caps).

products.name: CapFormer Systems Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary CapFormer Systems, which are manufacturing units for the production of PET closures, to commercial partners for external production of PET closures. This involves providing the technology and equipment necessary for partners to manufacture PET closures themselves.

products.name: Biometric Identity Verification
products.description: A cloud-based, software-as-a-service solution that verifies user identity by matching government-issued identity documents with live facial biometrics, eliminating the need for in-person ID checks. Delivered digitally via web or mobile applications.

products.name: Biometric Identity Authentication and Account Recovery
products.description: A cloud-based, passwordless authentication and account recovery service that uses facial biometrics for secure logins, transaction approvals, and recovery of account access, independent of device or hardware. Delivered via web or mobile applications.

products.name: PrivacyKey Privacy Preserving Biometrics
products.description: A biometric authentication solution using public/private key cryptography to verify identity without storing biometric data, ensuring privacy compliance. Delivered as a digital service via web or mobile.

products.name: Identity Exchange (IDX) Platform
products.description: A cloud-based platform for centralized, biometric-bound, passwordless identity management across large, distributed enterprises, enabling interoperable and reusable credentials for workforce identity governance. Delivered as a SaaS solution.

products.name: authID Mandate Agentic AI Security Framework
products.description: A digital framework that binds human sponsors to AI agents using biometrics, providing governance and an immutable audit trail for agentic activity. Delivered as a software platform for enterprise AI security.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of commercial loans including commercial and industrial (C&I) loans, commercial real estate loans, lender finance loans, construction loans, and government-guaranteed (SBA and USDA) loans to business clients. These loans are originated and serviced through physical branches and specialized lending teams, requiring in-person expertise and regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Deposit Services
products.description: Offers deposit accounts and cash management services to commercial clients, including specialized deposit channels for homeowners associations, title companies, political action committees, and not-for-profit organizations. Delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, leveraging regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Origination
products.description: Originates conventional and government-guaranteed residential mortgage loans nationwide, primarily for sale into the secondary market, using both in-person and direct-to-consumer digital channels. Requires regulated lending infrastructure and compliance with secondary market standards.

products.name: Consumer Credit Card Services (OpenSky™)
products.description: Provides secured, partially secured, and unsecured credit cards nationwide, primarily to under-banked populations and those rebuilding credit. Cards are digitally originated and serviced via web and mobile platforms, leveraging proprietary scoring models and data analytics.

products.name: Government Loan Servicing and Processing (Windsor Advantage™)
products.description: Offers outsourced SBA and USDA loan servicing, processing, and packaging for community banks and credit unions nationwide. Services are delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms, generating fee income from financial institution clients.

products.name: AI-Enabled Software Development Services
products.description: Custom and entrusted software development services for businesses, focused on building and deploying SaaS platforms that integrate artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and big data analytics. Delivered as tailored or increasingly standardized digital solutions to enterprise customers across various industries.

products.name: AI-Driven Enterprise Software Platforms and Applications
products.description: A suite of digital SaaS products including smart cloud collaboration, AI-enabled data analytics, workflow automation, security and compliance assurance, CRM, and supply chain optimization, all leveraging AI and cloud technologies. Delivered digitally to enterprise customers as modular or integrated solutions.

products.name: Bitcoin Acquisition and Holding
products.description: Acquisition and holding of Bitcoin as a digital asset for trading and investment purposes, managed through institutional-grade custodians. The company uses excess liquid assets and capital raising to purchase and hold Bitcoin, periodically selling or leveraging holdings as part of treasury management.

products.name: Mears Silicon Technology (MST) Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary MST thin-film silicon technology to semiconductor manufacturers, enabling them to enhance transistor performance, reduce power consumption, and improve yield using existing manufacturing equipment. Delivered through commercial license agreements with upfront fees and ongoing royalties.

products.name: MSTcad Software Licensing
products.description: Licensing of MSTcad simulation software, which runs on Synopsys’ TCAD platform, allowing semiconductor engineers to model and predict the benefits of integrating MST into their devices. Delivered as a software license to customers for use in design and process simulation.

products.name: Integration Engineering Services
products.description: Fee-based engineering services to assist customers in evaluating, integrating, and optimizing MST technology within their semiconductor manufacturing processes. Delivered through paid evaluation arrangements, joint development agreements, or integration license agreements.

products.name: MST-Enabled Substrate Solutions for Compound Semiconductors
products.description: Development and provision of MST-enabled substrates, particularly for GaN-on-Silicon and other compound semiconductor applications, to improve crystalline quality and yield for power and RF devices. Delivered as a technology solution to wafer manufacturers and device makers.

products.name: Accredited Calibration Services
products.description: Provision of accredited calibration services for test, measurement, and control instruments, delivered via in-house service centers, onsite at customer facilities, mobile labs, or client-based labs. Requires specialized technical labor, regulated processes, and accredited quality systems.

products.name: Test, Measurement, and Control Instrument Distribution
products.description: Distribution of professional grade handheld and bench test, measurement, and control instruments from national and proprietary brands, sold through online, in-house sales, and catalogs. Involves inventory management, warehousing, and logistics.

products.name: Test, Measurement, and Control Instrument Rental
products.description: Rental of electronic and mechanical test, measurement, and control instruments, including specialized rental tools for industries such as oil and gas. Delivered from dedicated warehouses and supported by logistics and technical staff.

products.name: Asset Management and Optimization Services (Transcat Solutions)
products.description: Comprehensive asset management services for regulated industries, including calibration, maintenance, reliability, computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), quality and compliance, and validation. Delivered via consulting, technical teams, and proprietary software.

products.name: Laboratory Instrument Services (Repair, Inspection, Preventative Maintenance, Analytical Qualifications)
products.description: Repair, inspection, preventative maintenance, and analytical qualification services for laboratory instruments, delivered onsite or at service centers by trained technicians. Supports compliance and operational reliability for regulated customers.

products.name: Commissioning, Qualification, and Validation (CQV) Services
products.description: Commissioning, qualification, and validation services for equipment and facilities, including cleaning and sterilization validation, process and software validation, and environmental mapping. Delivered by technical and compliance experts, often for life sciences customers.

products.name: Proprietary Asset Management Software (CalTrak® and C3®)
products.description: Provision of proprietary asset management and calibration documentation software (CalTrak® and C3®) to external customers, enabling web-based calibration cycle management, compliance tracking, and integration with customer systems. Delivered as a digital solution, validated for regulatory compliance.

products.name: Used Equipment Sales
products.description: Sales of used test, measurement, and control instruments, sourced from inventory and distributed through dedicated warehouses. Supports customers seeking cost-effective equipment options.

products.name: Equipment Kitting Services
products.description: Provision of equipment kitting services, assembling customized sets of instruments and accessories, particularly valued in sectors like power generation. Delivered through distribution operations and logistics teams.

products.name: Gold Mining and Production
products.description: Development and planned future operation of the Mt Todd Gold Project, involving the extraction and processing of gold ore using contract mining, third-party power generation, and a processing plant with crushing, grinding, sorting, and carbon-in-leach recovery circuits. The product is physically mined and processed gold, delivered through regulated, capital-intensive infrastructure.

products.name: Packaged Meats Products
products.description: Processed fresh meat into a wide variety of packaged meats, including bacon, sausage, hot dogs, deli and lunch meats, dry sausage, ham products, ready-to-eat products, and prepared foods. Manufactured in highly automated plants and delivered to retail and foodservice customers primarily in the U.S. under various brands and private labels.

products.name: Fresh Pork Products
products.description: Processes live hogs into primal, sub-primal, and offal products such as bellies, butts, hams, loins, picnics, and ribs. Products are sold to domestic retail, foodservice, industrial customers, and export markets. Requires regulated slaughter and processing facilities.

products.name: Hog Production and Livestock Sales
products.description: Produces and raises hogs on company-owned and contract farms, selling live hogs primarily for internal processing but also to external customers. Also sells livestock feed and grains and provides transportation and ancillary services to external customers.

products.name: Packaged Meats and Fresh Pork Products (Mexico)
products.description: Raises hogs and produces fresh pork products in Mexico, primarily for sale to customers in Mexico. Operations include company-owned farms and a manufacturing plant.

products.name: Bioscience Products (Heparin and Pharmaceutical Ingredients)
products.description: Manufactures heparin products, including active pharmaceutical ingredients derived from hogs, for use in pharmaceutical drugs and medical devices. Products are sold to the healthcare industry.

products.name: Pet Food and Treats
products.description: Produces value-added items such as pork skins for snacking and pet food and treats using fresh pork products. Manufactured in specialized processing plants and sold to industrial and retail customers.

products.name: Antibody Therapeutics for Androgenetic Alopecia (AGA)
products.description: Biologic therapies, specifically antibody-based therapeutics such as ABS-201, designed and developed using AI-driven models and wet-lab validation to treat pattern hair loss by targeting the prolactin receptor (PRLR) pathway. These are manufactured through biotechnological processes and delivered as injectable biologics, subject to clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: Antibody Therapeutics for Endometriosis
products.description: Antibody-based biologic therapies, such as ABS-201, developed using AI-driven design and wet-lab validation, targeting the PRLR pathway for the treatment of endometriosis. These are manufactured via biotechnological processes and intended for non-hormonal, non-surgical intervention, pending clinical and regulatory milestones.

products.name: Antibody Therapeutics for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) and Other Indications
products.description: Antibody-based biologic therapies, such as ABS-101, designed using AI and wet-lab validation for the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease and potentially other indications. These are developed through biotechnological manufacturing and may be advanced internally or through partnerships.

products.name: Antibody Therapeutics for Oncology and Immunology/Inflammation
products.description: Early-stage antibody-based biologic therapies, including assets like ABS-301 (oncology) and ABS-501 (HER2 program), developed using AI-driven design and wet-lab validation for cancer and immunology/inflammation indications. These are manufactured via biotechnological processes and may be advanced internally or through out-licensing/partnerships.

products.name: Drug Creation Partnerships and Out-Licensing of Antibody Therapeutics
products.description: Provision of AI-driven antibody drug discovery and optimization services to third-party biopharmaceutical companies, leveraging the Integrated Drug Creation platform to design, validate, and optimize antibody-based therapeutics for partners’ pipelines. Revenue is generated through upfront fees, research funding, milestones, and royalties.

products.name: Prescription Pet Medications
products.description: Prescription medications for dogs, cats, and horses, including branded, generic, and compounded drugs, are dispensed through licensed online and in-house pharmacies, requiring veterinarian approval and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Pet Health Products
products.description: Non-prescription health and wellness products, including OTC medications, supplements, vitamins, hygiene products, and flea and tick preventatives, are sold directly to consumers via digital platforms and fulfillment centers.

products.name: Pet Food and Treats
products.description: A broad assortment of prescription (Rx) and non-prescription (non-Rx) pet foods and treats, including premium and veterinary diets, are sourced from manufacturers and distributed through e-commerce and fulfillment centers.

products.name: Private Label Pet Health Products
products.description: Exclusive private label products such as joint enhancers, vitamins, shampoos, and flea and tick prevention are developed and sold under company brands, both direct-to-consumer and through third-party channels like Amazon.

products.name: Pet Supplies
products.description: A comprehensive assortment of pet supplies, including non-consumable products, is offered through e-commerce and retail channels, sourced from manufacturers and distributors.

products.name: Pet Telemedicine Services
products.description: Virtual veterinary consultations and telemedicine services are provided through partnerships, enabling pet owners to access board-certified veterinarians for consultations, diagnoses, and prescriptions remotely.

products.name: Pet Insurance Products
products.description: Pet insurance products are offered through strategic partnerships, providing co-branded insurance plans to pet owners and distributed via digital and brokered channels.

products.name: Employee Pet Benefits Programs
products.description: Bundled pet care solutions, including membership programs with discounts, telehealth, pet training, and delivery services, are offered to employers as part of employee wellness benefits.

products.name: Pet Health Educational Content
products.description: Educational articles and resources on pet health, behavior, nutrition, and remedies are provided to consumers through content websites and blogs as a value-added service.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Provision of regulated electricity services, including generation (from hydro, coal, natural gas, wind, and solar), transmission, and distribution to residential, commercial, industrial, and wholesale customers. This involves physical infrastructure such as power plants, transmission lines, and distribution networks, and is delivered under regulated tariffs.

products.name: Natural Gas Utility Services
products.description: Provision of regulated natural gas services, including production, purchase, storage, transmission, and distribution to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. This service is delivered via extensive pipeline networks, storage fields, and city gate stations, and is regulated by state commissions.

products.name: Wholesale Electric Transmission Services
products.description: Provision of wholesale electric transmission services to nonregulated entities, utilities, cooperatives, and power marketers, including firm and non-firm transmission under FERC-regulated tariffs. This service utilizes high-voltage transmission infrastructure and is governed by open access transmission tariffs.

products.name: Natural Gas Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of natural gas for third-party marketers and large end-users through the company's pipeline and distribution systems in South Dakota and Nebraska. This service is provided under regulated tariffs and involves the use of owned transmission and distribution pipelines.

products.name: Solar Tracker Systems
products.description: Intelligent, integrated solar tracker systems (including NX Horizon and its variants) that physically mount and rotate solar panels to follow the sun, increasing energy yield for utility-scale and distributed generation solar power plants. These systems are manufactured using contract manufacturing and delivered as large-scale hardware solutions with embedded sensors and control systems.

products.name: Energy Yield Management Software
products.description: Software solutions (such as TrueCapture) that optimize solar plant energy production by leveraging real-time site data, advanced sensors, and topographical calibration to dynamically adjust tracker positions. Delivered as licensed software integrated with tracker hardware or as upgrades to existing installations.

products.name: Solar Plant Monitoring and Control Software
products.description: Digital platforms (such as NX Navigator) that provide real-time monitoring, control, and weather risk mitigation for solar power plants, enabling remote operation, safety stowing, and operational analytics. Delivered as cloud-based or on-premise software licensed to plant owners and operators.

products.name: Solar Foundation Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive suite of solar foundation technologies and services (including NX Foundation Solutions and NX Anchor) designed to optimize solar project installations across diverse soil conditions. Includes foundation system hardware, geotechnical reviews, foundation design, equipment selection, and installation support, delivered as a combination of physical products and engineering services.

products.name: Electrical Balance of Systems (eBOS) Solutions
products.description: Engineered, pre-assembled electrical infrastructure components (such as those from Bentek) that collect and transport electricity from solar panels to the power grid. Offered as standalone, industry-compatible components or integrated with tracker systems, these products are manufactured and delivered as physical hardware for solar projects.

products.name: Risk Mitigation and Operability Solutions
products.description: Licensed software and system features that enhance the resilience and operability of solar tracking systems, including weather event protection (hail, hurricane/typhoon stow), remote diagnostics, and system upgrades for both new and existing installations. Delivered as software modules or firmware updates integrated with tracker hardware.

products.name: Women's Apparel
products.description: A wide selection of trend-right sportswear, outerwear, sleepwear, lingerie, scrubs, and plus-size clothing for women, sourced from both private label and national brands, delivered through physical retail stores.

products.name: Children's Apparel
products.description: A broad assortment of basics, fashion, and trend-driven clothing for boys (up to size 20), girls (up to size 16), newborns, infants, toddlers, including uniforms, accessories, and sleepwear, sold in stores.

products.name: Men's Apparel
products.description: A wide selection of trend-right sportswear and outerwear for men and big men, sourced from private label and national brands, available in physical stores.

products.name: Accessories & Beauty Products
products.description: Fashionable handbags, luggage, hats, belts, sunglasses, jewelry, watches, underwear, socks, and beauty and fragrance products for men and women, sourced from various vendors and sold in stores.

products.name: Home & Lifestyle Products
products.description: Home goods for bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, decorative accessories, and a mix of wants and needs such as books, food, tech products, team sports products, toys, health and beauty products, and seasonal items, sold through retail stores.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Casual and dress footwear for men, women, and children, sourced from private label and national brands, sold in physical stores as part of a family-focused assortment.

products.name: Digital Asset Trading and Financing Services
products.description: Provides institutional clients with OTC spot and derivatives trading, lending, and structured products on a principal basis, including margin lending, revolving credit, and miner financing. Delivered via electronic and voice execution platforms, requiring regulated financial infrastructure and advanced trading technology.

products.name: Investment Banking Services for Digital Assets Sector
products.description: Offers M&A advisory, capital raising, and restructuring services to public and private companies in the digital assets industry. Delivered by licensed broker-dealers and investment professionals, generating fee income based on transaction value or capital raised.

products.name: Digital Asset Asset Management
products.description: Manages a suite of investment vehicles, including ETFs (passive and active), hedge funds, and alternative strategies, providing institutional and individual investors with exposure to digital assets. Delivered through regulated investment management entities, generating management and performance fees.

products.name: Venture Capital and Private Equity Investing in Digital Assets Ecosystem
products.description: Invests in early-stage companies, protocols, and software infrastructure within the digital assets sector, including content, technology, and financialized applications. Delivered through managed venture funds and direct investments, leveraging financial capital and industry expertise.

products.name: Blockchain Infrastructure Solutions (Staking, Tokenization, Custody)
products.description: Provides institutional clients with blockchain infrastructure services, including staking (validator node operation), tokenization of real-world assets, and secure custodial technology (cold and hot wallets). Delivered via proprietary technology platforms and infrastructure, supporting on-chain participation and asset security.

products.name: Retail Financial Technology Platform (GalaxyOne)
products.description: Provides individual investors with access to FDIC-insured high-yield deposit accounts, debt securities, and commission-free trading in equities and crypto assets via a digital platform. Delivered through partnerships with regulated banks and brokerages, leveraging digital interfaces and compliance infrastructure.

products.name: High-Performance Computing (HPC) Data Center Leasing
products.description: Develops and leases large-scale, power-ready data center infrastructure to cloud service providers and AI/HPC clients. Delivered through physical construction, retrofitting, and operation of data center campuses with high power capacity and advanced cooling and connectivity.

products.name: Antigen-Specific Immune Tolerance Therapies for Autoimmune and Inflammatory Diseases
products.description: Therapeutic drug candidates developed using the proprietary SNAP-TI platform, which employs synthetic, self-assembling nanoparticles to deliver disease-specific antigens and immunomodulators, aiming to induce immune tolerance by modulating T cell responses. These are manufactured through advanced nanoparticle formulation and delivered via intramuscular or subcutaneous injection.

products.name: Immunotherapeutic Treatments for Chronic Hepatitis B
products.description: Immunotherapy drug candidates (e.g., VTP-300) based on viral vector platforms (Chimpanzee Adenovirus Oxford and Modified Vaccinia Ankara) designed to stimulate disease-specific CD8+ T cell responses to achieve functional cure in chronic hepatitis B patients. These are biologically manufactured and administered as part of combination regimens.

products.name: Immunotherapeutic Vaccines for Infectious Diseases and Oncology (Legacy Assets)
products.description: Legacy pipeline of immunotherapeutic vaccines (e.g., VTP-500 for MERS, VTP-850 for prostate cancer) based on viral vector and nanoparticle platforms, designed to induce targeted immune responses for prevention or treatment of infectious diseases and cancer. These are advanced biologics requiring complex manufacturing and are currently only to be developed with external partners.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity to residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal customers, primarily through physical infrastructure such as power plants, transmission lines, and substations. Service is regulated and delivered via owned and operated assets.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Retail sale and distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers, as well as transportation of customer-owned natural gas, using an extensive network of distribution and transmission pipelines. Services are regulated and require significant physical infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipeline Transportation and Storage Services
products.description: Transportation and storage of natural gas for local distribution companies, industrial customers, marketers, and others, using a regulated network of transmission pipelines and underground storage fields. Services are provided primarily through long-term contracts and regulated tariffs.

products.name: Cathodic Protection and Energy-Related Services
products.description: Provision of non-regulated energy-related services, specializing in cathodic protection to prevent pipeline corrosion, delivered through in-person technical labor and field services.

products.name: Machine Vision Systems and Sensors
products.description: Integrated hardware and software solutions, including smart cameras and sensors, that automate inspection, measurement, identification, and guidance tasks in manufacturing and logistics. These systems are manufactured using third-party contractors and in-house assembly, and leverage AI, deep learning, and edge learning technologies.

products.name: Vision Software Platforms
products.description: Software suites and platforms, such as VisionPro and OneVision, that provide advanced vision tools, AI model training, and application development for use with Cognex or third-party hardware. Delivered as both on-premise and cloud-based solutions, supporting integration and scalability for industrial customers.

products.name: Industrial Barcode Readers and Verifiers
products.description: Image-based barcode readers and verifiers, including fixed-mount and handheld models, designed for high-speed reading and traceability of 1D, 2D, and direct part mark codes in industrial environments. Products are manufactured using contract manufacturers and distributed globally.

products.name: Vision Accessories and Optical Components
products.description: Cameras, lenses, lighting, vision controllers, frame grabbers, and I/O cards designed to complement Cognex vision systems and software, supporting a variety of image acquisition and integration needs. Includes both in-house manufactured and sourced components.

products.name: Maintenance, Support, Consulting, and Training Services
products.description: After-sales services including hardware and software maintenance, technical support, consulting for application integration, and training courses for product use. Delivered by Cognex personnel at customer sites, regional offices, and online.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides loans, deposit accounts, treasury and cash management services, and risk management products to small businesses, middle market, and large commercial customers. Delivery requires regulated banking infrastructure, in-person relationship management, and technology platforms.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Offers retail lending (including mortgages), deposit accounts, and small business banking through a branch network. Services are delivered via physical branches, digital channels, and regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provides fiduciary services, private banking, investment advisory, and asset management to high net-worth clients and institutions. Delivered through licensed professionals and regulated investment platforms.

products.name: Mortgage Banking
products.description: Originates, sells, and services residential mortgage loans, and provides mortgage loan servicing for third parties. Requires specialized lending staff, regulatory compliance, and servicing infrastructure.

products.name: Brokerage and Trading Services
products.description: Engages in retail and institutional securities sales, municipal bond underwriting, and trading of U.S. government agency mortgage-backed securities and related derivatives. Delivered via broker/dealer subsidiaries and trading desks.

products.name: Commodity Derivatives and Energy Financing
products.description: Offers commodity derivatives and specialized financing solutions for energy sector clients, leveraging expertise in energy markets. Delivered through regulated banking channels and risk management professionals.

products.name: Electronic Funds Network Services (TransFund)
products.description: Operates an electronic funds transfer network providing ATM and debit card processing and related payment services to financial institutions and businesses. Delivered via proprietary technology infrastructure.

products.name: Bad Daddy’s Burger Bar Restaurants
products.description: Full-service, casual dining restaurants offering chef-driven, customizable burgers, sandwiches, salads, appetizers, and a full bar with craft beers and proprietary cocktails. Food is prepared in-house with scratch-made sauces and dressings, and alcoholic beverages are available for both on-premises and off-premises consumption where allowed.

products.name: Good Times Burgers & Frozen Custard Restaurants
products.description: Quick-service, drive-thru restaurants focused on all-natural burgers, chicken sandwiches, chicken tenders, breakfast burritos, and fresh frozen custard desserts. Most locations have drive-thru and outdoor patio seating, with a menu emphasizing speed, quality, and unique flavor profiles, including rotating limited-time items.

products.name: Franchising and Licensing of Restaurant Brands
products.description: Franchising and licensing of Good Times Burgers & Frozen Custard and Bad Daddy’s Burger Bar brands to third-party operators, including franchise agreements for Good Times and a license agreement for a Bad Daddy’s location in an airport. The company provides menu, management training, and marketing support to franchisees and licensees.

products.name: Immunomodulatory Therapeutics for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Drug candidates, including rezpegaldesleukin and preclinical agents like NKTR-0165 and NKTR-0166, designed to selectively modulate immune pathways (e.g., IL-2 receptor, TNFR2) to restore immune balance and treat autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. These are biologic drugs delivered via injection and require advanced biologics manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Immunomodulatory Therapeutics for Oncology
products.description: Drug candidates such as NKTR-255, designed to activate immune pathways (e.g., IL-15 pathway) to enhance the body’s innate and adaptive immune response against cancer. These are biologic drugs, often used in combination with other therapies, and require biologics manufacturing and clinical trials.

products.name: PEGylation and Advanced Polymer Conjugate Technology Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary PEGylation and polymer conjugate technologies to pharmaceutical partners for the development of improved biologic and small molecule drugs. This involves providing intellectual property rights and technical know-how, not direct manufacturing, following the sale of the manufacturing facility.

products.name: Out-Licensed PEGylated Drug Products (Legacy and Partnered)
products.description: Royalties and milestone revenues from out-licensed, partner-marketed PEGylated drugs (e.g., ADYNOVATE, MOVANTIK, CIMZIA, MIRCERA, Macugen, Somavert, Dapirolizumab Pegol), where Nektar contributed PEGylation technology or drug invention. These are commercialized by partners and Nektar receives non-cash royalty revenue.

products.name: MedSurg Solutions
products.description: A broad portfolio of medical and surgical products including negative pressure wound therapy, advanced wound dressings, skin care, synthetic tissue matrices, I.V. site management, sterilization assurance, temperature management, surgical supplies, medical tapes and wraps, stethoscopes, and medical electrodes. These are physically manufactured products delivered to healthcare providers and are designed to accelerate healing, prevent complications, and lower the total cost of care.

products.name: Dental and Orthodontic Solutions
products.description: A comprehensive suite of dental and orthodontic products including brackets, aligners, restorative cements, and bonding agents for preventative care, restoration, and orthodontic needs. These are manufactured medical devices and materials delivered to dental professionals for use in patient care.

products.name: Health Information Systems
products.description: Software solutions for healthcare systems, including computer-assisted physician documentation, coding automation, classification methodologies, speech recognition, and data visualization platforms. These are digital-only products delivered as software to healthcare providers to improve administrative efficiency and support value-based care.

products.name: Amwell Platform (Enterprise Digital Care Delivery Platform)
products.description: A cloud-based, configurable software platform enabling hybrid care delivery (in-person, virtual, automated) for health systems, health plans, employers, and government entities. Delivered as a recurring subscription SaaS product, it integrates with EHRs, claims, and other healthcare systems, and supports a wide range of digital care programs and workflows.

products.name: Virtual Clinical Services (via Amwell Medical Group)
products.description: A nationwide network of multi-disciplinary providers delivering virtual medical services (urgent care, primary care, behavioral health, specialty care) to patients and members, available 24/7/365. Services are provided on a fee-for-service basis, augmenting client capacity or serving as the primary clinical supply.

products.name: Carepoint Devices and Services
products.description: Proprietary hardware (carts, peripherals, and software) that enable digital access points in clinical and community settings, supporting virtual nursing, patient monitoring, and other digital care delivery. Includes device management, fleet monitoring, and integration services.

products.name: Automated Care Programs and Digital Behavioral Health Services
products.description: Digital, condition-specific automated care programs and digital mental health tools that engage patients before, after, or between visits to improve adherence and outcomes. Delivered via the Amwell Platform, these programs can escalate to virtual or in-person care as needed.

products.name: Professional and Implementation Services
products.description: A suite of paid services including implementation, workflow design, systems integration, service expansion, and patient/provider engagement to support client adoption and optimization of digital care solutions. Delivered by Amwell staff as project-based or ongoing support.

products.name: Specialty Digital Care Programs (via Partners)
products.description: A portfolio of digital specialty care programs (e.g., musculoskeletal, dermatology, cardiometabolic, second opinion) delivered through best-of-breed partners and integrated into the Amwell Platform, enabling clients to offer expanded specialty care digitally.

products.name: Multifamily Apartment Rental
products.description: Leasing of multifamily apartment units to residents, primarily in non-gateway U.S. markets. Properties are owned, operated, and managed by the company, with leases typically for a term of one year or less. Delivery requires physical real estate assets, on-site property management, and compliance with housing regulations.

products.name: Multifamily Apartment Property Management Services (Internal Only)
products.description: Management of apartment properties, including rental, leasing, operation, and maintenance. As of December 31, 2025, all managed units are owned by the company; there is no evidence of third-party management services being offered externally.

products.name: Preferred Equity Investments and Joint Venture Development of Multifamily Properties
products.description: Provision of capital through preferred equity investments and participation in joint ventures with developers for the development of new multifamily apartment communities. This involves financial capital and partnership structures, not direct property management.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Placement and consulting for nearly all lines of commercial property/casualty and health and welfare insurance coverage, delivered through a global network of sales and service offices. Services include risk assessment, policy placement, and ongoing client support, requiring licensed professionals and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Reinsurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage and advisory services for insurance companies and managing general underwriters to secure reinsurance protection, including negotiation of rates and terms, and capital markets services such as insurance-linked securities. Delivered by specialist brokers with analytics capabilities and global office presence.

products.name: Wholesale Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Placement of specialized and hard-to-place insurance coverages for retail brokers and non-affiliated brokers, including managing general agency and underwriter programs. Services are delivered through a network of offices and involve marketing, underwriting (without assuming risk), policy issuance, and claims negotiation.

products.name: Third-Party Claims Administration and Risk Management Services
products.description: Contract claim settlement, claim administration, loss control, and risk management consulting for entities that self-insure or outsource claims management. Delivered by claims adjusters and service personnel through a global office network, requiring regulated processes and in-person expertise.

products.name: Employee Benefits and Human Resources Consulting
products.description: Consulting services for employer-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare, retirement, executive benefits, and human resources advisory. Delivered by specialized consultants and supported by analytics, requiring regulatory compliance and industry expertise.

products.name: Captive Insurance and Alternative Risk Transfer Solutions
products.description: Development and management of captive insurance entities, rent-a-captive facilities, and alternative market mechanisms for clients seeking customized risk financing. Services include captive formation, management, and administration, requiring regulatory capital and specialized expertise.

products.name: Insurance Analytics and Technology Solutions
products.description: Provision of data analytics, benchmarking, and digital platforms (e.g., Gallagher Drive, SmartMarket) to support insurance decision-making, risk identification, and performance measurement for clients and insurance carriers. Delivered as digital services leveraging proprietary technology and data.

products.name: Casino Gaming Operations
products.description: Operation of full-service casinos offering slot machines, table games, and related gaming activities at owned or leased properties. Requires significant physical infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and in-person customer service.

products.name: Hotel and Resort Accommodations
products.description: Provision of hotel rooms and resort amenities at casino properties, including luxury guest rooms, pools, spas, and convention facilities. Delivered through physical hospitality infrastructure and in-person service.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Operation of on-site restaurants, bars, buffets, and quick-service outlets at casino and hotel properties. Requires physical facilities and in-person staff.

products.name: Sports Wagering (Retail and Online)
products.description: Provision of sports betting services both on-site at casinos and through contracted online sports wagering websites ('skins'). Involves regulated digital platforms and/or physical sportsbooks.

products.name: Golf Course Operations
products.description: Operation of an 18-hole golf course at the Rising Star Casino Resort, requiring physical land, facilities, and in-person staff.

products.name: Recreational Vehicle (RV) Park Services
products.description: Provision of RV park accommodations at certain casino properties, involving physical sites and basic hospitality services.

products.name: Ferry Boat Transportation Service
products.description: Operation of a ferry boat service connecting Kentucky to the Rising Star Casino Resort in Indiana, requiring regulated transportation infrastructure and staff.

products.name: Convention and Meeting Facilities
products.description: Rental of meeting and convention space at casino resorts, requiring dedicated physical facilities and event services staff.

products.name: Versamune-based Cancer Immunotherapies
products.description: Immunotherapies for cancer treatment based on the proprietary Versamune® platform, which uses cationic lipid nanoparticles combined with tumor-specific antigens to stimulate robust CD8 and CD4 T cell responses. Delivered via subcutaneous injection, these therapies are manufactured using scalable fill-finish processes and rely on third-party contract manufacturing organizations.

products.name: PDS0101 (HPV-Related Cancer Immunotherapy)
products.description: A Versamune®-based immunotherapy product combining the platform with HPV16-derived peptides for the treatment of HPV-related cancers, including head and neck, cervical, anal, vaginal, vulvar, and penile cancers. Administered via subcutaneous injection and manufactured using third-party contractors.

products.name: PDS0103 (MUC1-Related Cancer Immunotherapy)
products.description: A Versamune®-based immunotherapy product combining the platform with novel, highly immunogenic MUC1 epitopes for the treatment of MUC1-expressing cancers such as ovarian, breast, colorectal, and lung cancers. Delivered by subcutaneous injection and manufactured externally.

products.name: PDS01ADC (IL-12 Antibody Drug Conjugate Immunocytokine)
products.description: A novel investigational antibody-drug conjugate consisting of interleukin-12 fused to a tumor-targeting IgG1 antibody, designed to enhance T cell proliferation and function in the tumor microenvironment. Used as monotherapy or in combination with Versamune®-based immunotherapies for various solid tumors. Administered subcutaneously and manufactured by third parties.

products.name: Combination Immunotherapy Regimens (Versamune-based Products plus Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors or Chemoradiotherapy)
products.description: Therapeutic regimens combining Versamune®-based immunotherapies (such as PDS0101) with immune checkpoint inhibitors (e.g., pembrolizumab/Keytruda®) or standard-of-care chemoradiotherapy for enhanced cancer treatment efficacy. Delivered via injection and standard infusion protocols, with manufacturing outsourced.

products.name: Infectimune-based Infectious Disease Vaccines
products.description: Vaccines for infectious diseases developed using the Infectimune® cationic lipid platform, designed to induce both T cell and antibody responses for durable protection. Manufactured using scalable processes and delivered via injection, with third-party manufacturing.

products.name: PDS0202 (Universal Influenza Vaccine)
products.description: A universal influenza vaccine candidate combining Infectimune® technology with computationally designed influenza antigens to generate broad and durable immune responses across multiple flu strains. Manufactured externally and delivered by injection.

products.name: Energy Drinks
products.description: A broad portfolio of carbonated and non-carbonated energy drinks, including flagship Monster Energy, Monster Energy Ultra, Java Monster (coffee + energy), Rehab Monster (tea-based), Monster Energy Nitro, and other sub-brands. products.name: Performance and Wellness Energy Drinks
products.description: High-performance and wellness-focused energy drinks, including Reign Total Body Fuel (with BCAAs, electrolytes, CoQ10) and Reign Storm (with natural caffeine, vitamins, zero sugar), targeting fitness and health-conscious consumers. products.name: Affordable and International Energy Drinks
products.description: A range of affordable and regionally targeted energy drinks under brands such as Predator, Fury, Burn, Mother, Nalu, Play, Power Play, Relentless, BPM, BU, Samurai, Ultra Energy, and others. products.description: A line of better-for-you lifestyle energy drinks with B vitamins, essential amino acids, and unique flavor profiles, marketed under the Bang Energy brand. Manufactured at company-owned facilities and distributed in ready-to-drink cans.

products.name: Alcoholic Beverages (Craft Beers, Flavored Malt Beverages, Hard Seltzers)
products.description: A portfolio of alcoholic beverages including craft beers (under brands like Cigar City, Oskar Blues, Deep Ellum, Squatters, Wasatch, Perrin), flavored malt beverages (Blind Lemon, Blinder Lemon, The Beast, Beast Tea), and hard seltzers (Wild Basin). products.name: Licensed Non-Beverage Merchandise
products.description: Non-beverage products such as clothing, backpacks, hats, t-shirts, jackets, helmets, and automotive wheels bearing the Company’s trademarks, sold through licensing agreements with third parties.

products.name: Human Nutrition Ingredients and Solutions
products.description: Manufactures and supplies human-grade choline nutrients, mineral amino acid chelates, specialty vitamin K2, MSM, and provides customized ingredient systems and microencapsulation solutions for food, beverage, and nutritional supplement manufacturers. products.name: Animal Nutrition Ingredients and Solutions
products.description: Produces and supplies nutritional products for animals, including microencapsulated nutrients, chelated minerals, choline chloride (dry and aqueous forms), and MSM, primarily for use in animal feed for ruminants, poultry, swine, and companion animals. products.name: Performance Gases and Chemicals
products.description: Repackages and distributes performance gases and chemicals, notably ethylene oxide, propylene oxide, and ammonia, for use as sterilants, fumigants, refrigerants, and in chemical synthesis. products.name: Plant Nutrition Products
products.description: Develops and sells chelated mineral micronutrient products for high-value crops, utilizing patented amino acid chelate technology and a two-step approach to optimize plant health, yield, and shelf life. products.name: Residential Furniture

products.name: Mattresses
products.description: Havertys offers nationally recognized mattress brands such as Tempur-Pedic, Serta, Stearns and Foster, Beautyrest, and Sealy, sold through its retail stores and online. products.name: Home Accessories
products.description: Havertys sells a variety of home accessories, including decorative items, which complement its furniture offerings. These are available in-store and online, and are sourced from various suppliers, requiring inventory management and delivery systems.

products.name: Custom Upholstery and Sectionals
products.description: Havertys provides custom upholstery and sectional furniture, allowing customers to personalize fabrics and configurations using in-store and online tools. products.name: Trauma and Extremities Implants
